# ProxyBridge

 

ProxyBridge is a free, open-source proxy client (Proxifier alternative) for **Windows**, **macOS** and **Linux**. It forces the applications you choose to use a SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy for their TCP and UDP traffic, even apps with no proxy settings or that ignore them, with no changes to the app. > [!TIP] > **ProxyBridge routes your traffic - [InterceptSuite](https://interceptsuite.com) lets you see inside it.** > Full MITM proxy with SSL/TLS inspection, live request editing, scripting, and support for TCP, UDP, StartTLS, DTLS, QUIC and more. Built by the same team. [**Try InterceptSuite →**](https://interceptsuite.com) ## Table of Contents - [Download](#download) - [Features](#features) - [Screenshots](#screenshots) - [InterceptSuite](#interceptsuite) - [License](#license) - [Author](#author) - [Credits](#credits)

Windows, macOS and Linux (x64 and arm64). Older versions: GitHub Releases. Per-platform guides: Windows, macOS, Linux

**macOS (Homebrew):** ```bash brew install --cask proxybridge ``` **Linux (one-command install):** ```bash curl -Lo deploy.sh https://raw.githubusercontent.com/InterceptSuite/ProxyBridge/refs/heads/master/Linux/deploy.sh && sudo bash deploy.sh ``` ## Features - **Per-process routing** - send traffic from chosen applications through SOCKS5 or HTTP proxies, or direct, or block it - **Works with proxy-unaware apps** - system-level interception, no changes to the application - **TCP and UDP** - HTTP/HTTPS, HTTP/3, SSH, RDP, databases, games, DTLS, DNS and more - **Flexible rules** - match processes, IPs, ports, protocols and host names, with wildcards and IPv4/IPv6 - **GUI and CLI** on Windows, macOS and Linux, with profiles and rule import/export > [!CAUTION] > **Beware of fake ProxyBridge downloads.** Some unofficial sites distribute malware under the ProxyBridge name. Download only from this repository or [interceptsuite.com/download/proxybridge](https://proxybridge.interceptsuite.com/download/), or build from source. ProxyBridge contacts no server except its update feed (`download.interceptsuite.com/proxybridge.json`), on launch or when you check for updates. ## Screenshots - [macOS screenshots](MacOS/README.md#overview) - [Windows screenshots](Windows/README.md#usage) - [Linux screenshots](Linux/README.md#gui-application) ## InterceptSuite ProxyBridge is a **proxy client** - it routes your application traffic through any SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy. It does not inspect or modify the traffic itself. **[InterceptSuite](https://interceptsuite.com)** is a **MITM SOCKS5 proxy server** built for traffic interception and analysis. Point ProxyBridge at InterceptSuite and you can inspect everything: - Full TLS/SSL interception and certificate spoofing - TCP, UDP, StartTLS, DTLS traffic analysis - Live request and response editing - Scripting and automation ProxyBridge routes the traffic in. InterceptSuite sees inside it. [**Try InterceptSuite →**](https://interceptsuite.com) ## License MIT License - See LICENSE file for details ## Author Sourav Kalal ([X](https://x.com/Ano_F_), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sourav-kalal/)) / InterceptSuite ([X](https://x.com/InterceptSuite), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/interceptsuite/)) ## Credits **Windows Implementation:** This project is built on top of [WinDivert](https://reqrypt.org/windivert.html) by basil00. WinDivert is a powerful Windows packet capture and manipulation library that makes kernel-level packet interception possible. Special thanks to the WinDivert project for providing such a robust foundation. Based on the StreamDump example from WinDivert: https://reqrypt.org/samples/streamdump.html The Windows GUI and CLI are written in native C using the Win32 API, keeping the footprint small and startup instant. **macOS Implementation:** Built using Apple's Network Extension framework for transparent proxy capabilities on macOS. **Linux Implementation:** Built on eBPF with a GTK3 GUI. See [Linux/README.md](Linux/README.md).
